errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart. The horizontal axis represents the numerical values (quantity), not the entity categories. The categories are listed on the vertical axis.
The vertical axis represents the entity categories (e.g., '疾病', '症状'), not the quantity ('实体数目'). The description incorrectly swaps the roles of the horizontal and vertical axes.

errors.evidence: This description of the scale belongs to the horizontal axis, but it is incorrectly attributed to the vertical axis in the machine-generated text. The vertical axis is categorical.
